name: STABLE PRODUCT GALLERY CROSSFADE
changes: Replaces the product gallery source-swap transition with a persistent two-buffer crossfade
Decodes the next gallery image completely before it becomes visible
Removes transform/zoom animation during slide changes to prevent compositor blinking
Keeps both image buffers mounted and never clears the visible layer source during a transition
Warms the remaining product-story images during idle time for smoother first manual swipe
Uses a stable edge overlay instead of WebKit masks on touch Apple devices after pinch zoom
Synchronizes public and Admin PWA cache versions to 13.8.18
